metadata.description: A curated public subset of Claude Code plugins: audio transcription, meeting notes, trip planning, and a session-cost stamp, plus the audio-transcription eval harness.

plugins.name: audio-transcription
plugins.description: Transcribe wav, mp3, and m4a recordings (meetings, calls, interviews, lectures, podcasts) into timestamped Markdown with Whisper: mlx-whisper on Apple Silicon, openai-whisper elsewhere.

plugins.name: meeting-notes
plugins.description: Process meeting transcripts from a rec/ folder into professional markdown summaries with isolation between transcripts.

plugins.name: session-cost-stamp
plugins.description: At session end, stamp the session's worked-time, context %, and cost into the transcript as a native ai-title entry (shows on resume, persists in the file). Requires a statusLine that writes the stash — see the plugin README.

plugins.name: trip-plan
plugins.description: Plan, review, and ship travel itineraries: sequence stops around opening hours and travel time, audit an existing plan, then publish it as a self-contained HTML file and an installable offline PWA.
